snow_map._about: Snowpack map (build/build_snow.py): contour lines drawn, which of them get a label, and the box [west, south, east, north] the labels must sit in.

weather._about: Weather tab (build/build_weather.py). Temperatures: Roosevelt, with the put-in estimated 3 F cooler (about 1000 ft higher, cooler canyon). Precipitation: the average of Roosevelt and Globe statistics. Cloud: NASA POWER at the canyon midpoint. Forecast: NWS at the put-in and take-out.

water_temp._about: No gauge here records water temperature continuously. USGS hydrographers measured it on ~390 visits to this gauge (1976-2019, Water Quality Portal). Water temperature is estimated from the 7-day average air temperature (NASA POWER at the gauge, a few days behind real time) and the time of year, fitted to those measurements.
